svg.title: Launching an Uber Fleet One SUV at a Time
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-uber-fleet-launch-sequence; chapter number: 1; chart type: process_flow; title: Launching an Uber Fleet One SUV at a Time; subtitle: Account setup, VIN-first insurance, one vehicle, renter vetting, weekly pricing; caption: Fleet operators sequence the launch so the costly mistakes happen on paper, not after the truck is bought: quote insurance on the VIN, start with one vehicle, and refuse renters who arrive without a limousine license and full payment.; assumptions note: Step order follows the practitioner gates as reported. The $600 Suburban rate and $794 Houston permit stickers are single-operator figures, not market-wide rates.; note: Sources are Norman Tutorials (70EXcECzC70 @ 00:01:33), TJackk (GBM9d0WqM-0 @ 00:20:42, 9mwQox6xtqw @ 00:02:56, 4NPuQA-V4ZA @ 00:04:57, UTnHLaPqh1s @ 00:04:02), and Rideshare Professor (tKKCFcEvdl4 @ 00:05:29, 7e3yD_HEDec @ 00:01:28, 4Y5_eWf85tM @ 00:13:13).; stages: step: 01; label: Open the Fleet account; value: Step 1; detail: Sign up for Uber Fleet and submit tax information carefully, double-checking it before continuing (Norman Tutorials).; step: 02; label: Quote insurance on the exact VIN; value: Step 2; detail: Get the commercial auto quote off the VIN before buying, because once the vehicle is bought the owner is stuck with it (TJackk).; step: 03; label: Buy one large black SUV; value: Step 3; detail: Start with one vehicle, not five (Rideshare Professor). Keep a reserve for licensing, permits such as $794 Houston stickers per SUV, insurance, and a surprise repair week (TJackk).; step: 04; label: Vet the renter before handoff; value: Step 4; detail: No limousine license and no full payment up front means no car; a repeating action-needed flag is a red alert for a bought account (TJackk).; step: 05; label: Charge weekly and monitor driving; value: Step 5; detail: Suburbans lease at $600 per week, Cadillacs $100 more; speeding over 80 earns one warning and the second time the driver is out (Rideshare Professor).

Get the commercial auto quote off the VIN before buying, because once the vehicle is bought the owner is stuck with it (TJackk).

rect.title: step: 03; label: Buy one large black SUV; value: Step 3; detail: Start with one vehicle, not five (Rideshare Professor). Keep a reserve for licensing, permits such as $794 Houston stickers per SUV, insurance, and a surprise repair week (TJackk).
